title: /mission for Claude Code
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
gap: Every agent product today still asks the human to be the project manager. The decomposition step — 'what are the five things this actually requires' — is the part non-technical people cannot do and the part nobody has packaged for them.

zh.gap: 今天所有 agent 产品仍然要求人来当项目经理。而「这件事到底需要哪五步」这个拆解动作，恰恰是非技术的人做不了、也没人替他们打包过的那一步。
zh.pain: 说得清自己要什么、但不知道怎么拆成步骤的人——也就是绝大多数人，只是碰巧现在用它的是开发者。
zh.kill: 正踩在几家大厂的路线图正中间：拆解一旦做好就会变成基座产品的默认能力，薄薄一层编排就没有立足之地了。
zh.move: 有意思的不是写代码那个版本，而是把同一套拆解对准普通人真正手上的非代码任务（「把我妈七十大寿从计划到落地办完」）。冷启动：中文＝小红书「AI 帮我做了⋯」类笔记的评论区；英文＝r/ChatGPT 里「我希望它直接把整件事做完」的讨论串。标 watch 不标 build：面向开发者的这个形态正是终端用户闸门要挡的。

pain: Someone who can describe what they want built but has no idea how to break it into steps — which is most people, and only incidentally developers.
kill: Squarely inside the biggest labs' roadmap: the moment decomposition works well it becomes a default in the base product, and a thin orchestration layer has no ground left to stand on.
move: The interesting version is not the coding one — it is the same decomposition pointed at a non-code mission a normal person actually has ('plan and produce my mother's 70th birthday'). Cold start CN = 小红书「AI 帮我做了」类笔记的评论区; EN = r/ChatGPT 'I wish it would just do the whole thing' threads. Flagged watch, not build: the developer-facing framing is exactly what the end-user gate rejects.
